01

“We know what the earth takes from them”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
We know what the earth takes from them [Qaf 4] meaning: "of their bones."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ [ق: 4] ، يَعْنِي: «مِنْ عِظَامِهِمْ»
Edition record 373398 · p. 613Link to report ↗

06

“Were We then exhausted by the first creation?”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Were We then exhausted by the first creation? [Qaf 15] he said: "He says: Were We exhausted when We brought you into being and originated your creation?"
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ [ق: 15] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: أَفَأُعْيِيَ عَلَيْنَا حِينَ أَنْشَأْنَاكُمْ وَأَنْشَأْنَا خَلْقَكُمْ "
Edition record 373404 · p. 614Link to report ↗

14

“Is there any more?”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

15
Explanation from Mujāhid 15

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Is there any more? [Qaf 30] he said: "God promised that He would fill it, so He says to it: 'Have I fulfilled you?' and it says: 'Is there any more?'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ [ق: 30] قَالَ: " وَعَدَهَا اللَّهُ لَيَمْلَأَنَّهَا، فَيَقُولُ لَهَا: هَلْ أَوْفَيْتُكِ؟ فَتَقُولُ: هَلْ مِنْ مَسْلَكٍ "

17

“and there did not touch Us any fatigue [lughub]”

Three explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and ʿAlī.

18
Explanation from Mujāhid 18

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and there did not touch Us any fatigue [lughub] [Qaf 38] he said: "The lughub is weariness; the Jews say that He grew weary after He, Mighty and Majestic, created them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُغُوبٍ [ق: 38] قَالَ: " اللَّغَبُ: النَّصَبُ، يَقُولُ الْيَهُوَدُ: إِنَّهُ أُعْيِيَ بَعْدَ مَا خَلَقَهُمَا عز وجل "
Edition record 373415 · p. 615Link to report ↗
19
Report from ʿAlī 19

ʿAlī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Masudi related to us, from Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani, from al-Harith, from Ali, who said:
"at the end of prostrations [Qaf 40]: the two rakas after the Maghrib." Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Israil related to us, from Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani, from al-Harith, from Ali, the like of it.
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ: أَدْبَارَ السُّجُودِ
«الرَّكْعَتَانِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ» . أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمَذَانِيِّ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، مِثْلَهُ
Edition record 373416 · p. 616Link to report ↗
20
Report from Mujāhid 20

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
Ibn Abbas said: "He commanded him to glorify [God] at the end of all the prayers."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ:
«أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَ فِي أَدْبَارِ الصَّلَوَاتِ كُلِّهَا»

18

“and you are not over them a tyrant”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

21
Explanation from Mujāhid 21

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
and you are not over them a tyrant [Qaf 45] He says: "do not be tyrannical toward them, O Muhammad."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: قَالَ:
وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ [ق: 45] يَقُولُ: «لَا تَتَجَبَّرْ عَلَيْهِمْ يَا مُحَمَّدُ»
